name: Imohara ~Loli na Imouto wa Matanity~
original_name: 妹孕～ロリーな妹は股ニティー～
source:
Your father has remarried and you've gained a new sister. You've never even had a girlfriend before. How will you handle living with a new younger sister?

A progress bar appears on the bottom of the screen as you play. Each time you ejaculate inside her it increases to show you how close she is to becoming pregnant!

Will you make a baby with your new sister?
